changes.title: Keep calendar offset controls active and retain editor evidence
changes.detail: Use a valid calendar offset when enabling the optional field. Scope release credentials to the publisher and only arm rollback after release creation. Document the verification results and include the published Repairs editor.

changes.title: Add visual editors for actions and dashboard elements
changes.detail:
Use integration metadata and entity capabilities for action choices. Keep existing media values, add precise insertion for text pieces, and let new actions inherit the all-actions setting. Use native Repairs controls and structured editing for dashboard elements without a supplied editor.

Extend the browser demo with sample media and a persistent dashboard. Add cancellable transfers and keep release build artifacts available for recovery.

changes.title: Record the verified local build and deployment handoff
changes.detail: The browser demo and guides are live. The production installation stays on its existing version until the published Core image passes its isolated browser check.
